independence: New rubric; historical V40/H20 oracle and negative failures unchanged.

exact_frozen_coverage.rule: OR across witness_sets, AND inside each set; literal case/symbol-preserving source text occurrence; all required facts for per-case pass
exact_frozen_coverage.partial: Only supported obligations in denominator; unavailable obligations reported separately, never manufactured.
exact_frozen_coverage.negative: No required fact denominator; report NA, not vacuous coverage PASS.
exact_frozen_coverage.warning: Literal coverage is neither entailment nor sufficient context. Alternative witnesses must be frozen, not added after outputs.

semantic_sufficiency.review_order: Stage 1 label-hidden question+anonymized packet only; Stage 2 independent sources/oracle reconciliation.
semantic_sufficiency.rule: Preserve conditions, negation, defaults vs example, code/operator roles; assess all requested obligations, not overlap. Quote packet spans for supported obligations and identify missing obligations.
semantic_sufficiency.boundary: AI assessment must be marked AI-assessed, not human-verified. No autorater implementation or paper accuracy claim is reproduced.

negative_empty_source.rule: Strict historical-compatible contract: negative passes only with sources=[] and no delivered evidence text. Source-valid topical text is still a failure of this metric.
negative_empty_source.contract: Separate from retrieval-only admission; no retrospective relabeling.

source_integrity.rule: Check every delivered occurrence against authorized project root/version/member, canonical original bytes, SHA and span; verify freshness and no foreign source/false answer or edit authority.
source_integrity.on_violation: Stop affected arm; integrity failure is not relevance failure.

actual_answer_quality.rule: Score generated answer separately for all documented facts, qualified partial/abstention, preserved conditions and unsupported claims; compare to independent original sources.
actual_answer_quality.without_generation: NOT MEASURED, never inferred from retrieval or semantic sufficiency.

unsupported_claims.rule: Count claims asserted without source support, including invented unavailable configuration, guarantee, numeric threshold, retention, default and operator semantics. Separate contradictory from merely undocumented claims.

cost_and_reporting.rule: Report native and fixed content-independent packed text separately; same frozen tokenizer and ceiling, attribution charged; equal ceiling is not equal spend. Record prepare/context/resource/model calls and raw setup failures separately. No merged quality/readiness PASS.
